purpose: Acquire only the Tushare daily_basic share-count fields required for one structural free-float-scarcity factor, first through a fixed completed-session acceptance and then, only if accepted, through one atomic 2019-2025 source snapshot before no-return capacity and uniqueness gates.

terminal_same_api_pb_record.separation: The terminal PB branch requested only ts_code,trade_date,pb and contains no share count. It cannot be resynced, reinterpreted, or used as free-float evidence.

source.request_mode: one completed local trading session per call

factor.name: tushare_free_float_scarcity
factor.economic_direction: less freely tradable supply relative to total shares means greater structural supply scarcity and is frozen as the higher score
factor.valid_source_row: total_share and free_share are both finite and strictly positive and free_share is no greater than total_share
factor.invalid_source_row_policy: exclude and count; never clip, absolutize, swap fields, fill, or infer a value

point_in_time_policy.source_row_availability: after the documented 15:00-17:00 update on trade_date
point_in_time_policy.earliest_entry: the next local trading session open after trade_date
point_in_time_policy.universe_membership: retain only a stock whose trade_date is inside its point-in-time buyable interval; exclude and count STAR, BSE, funds, bonds, and every outside-interval row

required_checks_before_large_sync: TUSHARE_TOKEN is present only in the child-process environment and is never logged
the response is positive and strictly below the documented 6000-row ceiling
stock-date keys are complete, unique, and equal to the fixed completed session
invalid or missing share-count rows are excluded and counted without repair
every retained local factor equals 1-free_share/total_share and lies in [0,1)
at least 95 percent of point-in-time buyable names have a valid factor
at least 50 names and two distinct factor values remain
no forbidden field, credential, price, score, or return is requested or stored
acceptance_protocol.failed_acceptance_policy: atomically delete any temporary frame, write one no-return rejection manifest, install a tracked terminal record, and stop without retry, another date, full history, capacity, uniqueness, prices, returns, aggregation, scoring, selection, sizing, orders, or Level-2

source_completeness_policy.failed_gate_policy: delete the full temporary snapshot and stop before factor capacity, comparison fields, prices, or returns; never fill missing shares, mix providers, shorten the dates, or request a substitute daily_basic field

no_return_capacity_policy.quality_gate: ROE >= 5%, positive net profit, positive revenue YoY, and positive profit YoY, effective only after the next local session following announcement
no_return_capacity_policy.failed_gate_policy: stop without comparison fields or returns; do not alter direction, field, denominator, dates, cohort spacing, quality, listing, or minimum thresholds

no_return_uniqueness_policy.method: Inside the same quality/listing-eligible daily cross-section, rank free-float scarcity and every frozen existing same-session comparison field, compute Spearman correlation by session, and take each comparison's median daily correlation.
no_return_uniqueness_policy.failed_gate_policy: stop without returns, inversion, a ratio change, size residualization, industry neutralization, a demand interaction, field substitution, or threshold relaxation

diagnostic_policy_if_all_no_return_gates.next_action: Freeze one new immutable single-factor return and prospective-execution diagnostic bound to the accepted full manifest and completed capacity/uniqueness audit.
